# onpager_team_alert_filter (Resource)

Manage one team or service CEL alert filter and its active state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onpager_team_alert_filter" "example" {
  team_id    = var.team_id
  cel_source = "false"
  active     = true
}

variable "team_id" {
  description = "Existing team UUID."
  type        = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cel_source` (String) CEL filter expression. Sent as typed CEL source, without JSON encoding.
- `team_id` (String) Owning team UUID. Changing it replaces this resource. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Desired active state, published atomically with content. Defaults to `true`. Inactive definitions remain readable and in state; a later apply reconciles this setting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Owning team UUID, also used as this filter's identity and import ID.
- `revision` (Number) Latest published revision; publication and disable do not use If-Match.

## Import

Import using the team UUID. Inactive definitions can be imported; a later apply
reconciles their content and `active` state.

Use an `import` block:

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_team_alert_filter.example
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
}
```

Or use the CLI:

```shell
terraform import onpager_team_alert_filter.example 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```

## Lifecycle

Manage at most one alert filter resource per team. Publication saves the CEL
expression and active state atomically in a new revision. Writes have no
revision precondition.

Activation requires an active owner. Publishing inactive content is permitted
under an inactive owner with the disable grant. Disabled definitions remain
directly readable with their identity and content.

Destroy disables the filter and preserves configuration and history. The owner
and other routing configuration remain independent. A failed disable retains
state; a later create can publish the owner's filter slot again.

## Permissions

Requires `alert_filters.read`, `alert_filters.publish` and
`alert_filters.disable` in the owning team. Service accounts require explicit
native grants.
